decided_by: user, 2026-10-08, round 4: judge the agent-written design (A) with codex gpt-6-luna and claude-sonnet-5-5, 10 runs each; an effect must exceed the up-to-10% run-to-run difference the user observed while developing codemap-search; precision is labeled on a seeded sample of 480 pairs, extended in steps of 480 while inconclusive; targets, mode, search settings, precision threshold, and hard limits are unchanged from criteria 2

search.order: displayed: the MCP search render order (directory-diversified detail head)

effect.population: medium and complex cases of the target whose baseline search (all terms joined by spaces) misses every gold path in its top_k; M = their count
effect.measure: a run finds a case when the baseline top_k or the top_k of one of its follow-up queries holds a gold path; per condition, found rate = mean over the M cases of the share of its 20 runs (2 searchers x 10 replicates, contracts/agent-loop-searchers.json) that find the case; treatment runs read the block, control runs do not
effect.rule: treatment found rate - control found rate > 0.10 (10 percentage points) for every target
effect.rule_reason: user: agent runs differ by up to 10% in codemap-search development; differences up to 10% are agent variance, not an effect of the block
effect.when_M_is_zero: not measurable; reported as such, not as a pass
effect.reported_not_judged: pooled over both targets, per searcher, and the rtl-2.4 mechanical paired comparison of evaluate_feature.py

precision.population: every related term the judged_mode block showed (label-queue.jsonl)
precision.labeler: codex gpt-6.1-sol (reasoning high), contracts/feature-precision-rubric-2.json, one label per pair in the case prompt's context
precision.sampling: label-queue.jsonl shuffled once with seed 20261008; pairs are labeled in that order in steps of 480
precision.rule: pooled useful rate on the labeled pairs with a Wilson 95% interval: pass if the lower bound >= 0.75, fail if the upper bound < 0.75, otherwise label the next 480 pairs; once every pair is labeled, pass if the rate >= 0.75

hard_limits.rule: in every mode and case: block_bytes <= 2048 and no identifier-shaped term expanded
